name: MAI Second Brain
description:
MAI is the agent-first second brain: notes built for an AI to read, not just a human. Most note apps were built for a human reader and bolted an AI on later — MAI is built the other way round. You fill it by voice on iPhone, Apple Watch or Mac, an AI notetaker covers your meetings, and everything you capture is structured so an agent can search it, cite it and write back to it. This MCP server is the front door, not a plugin.

Connected, Claude answers from your own words instead of like a stranger: "What did I decide about pricing?", "Summarize yesterday's meeting", "What should I focus on today?" It writes back carefully too — decisions become notes, commitments become tasks on today's list, follow-ups append to existing notes.

18 agent-ready tools, every one scoped to your account: hybrid keyword and semantic search, meeting transcripts, tasks, projects, recurring themes and your daily Focus Brief. Writes are additive by design — no delete tool exists, so notes can grow from a conversation but can't be lost to one. Three built-in prompts (daily-review, meeting-prep, weekly-retro) turn common rituals into one command.

Connecting takes a minute: sign in with your MAI account email and a one-time code — no password, no API key. Requires MAI Premium; every new account starts with a 7-day trial of everything.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MAI Second Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MAI Second Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://maicontext.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MAI Second Brain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAI Second Brain lists 18 MCP tools, including append_to_entry, assign_entry_to_project, create_task, create_text_entry, generate_actions_for_entry, get_current_focus, get_entry, get_focus_brief, get_meeting_transcript, get_user_themes, list_meetings, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MAI Second Brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MAI Second Brain in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does MAI Second Brain MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MAI Second Brain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MAI Second Brain is developed by Inteli Seko LTD. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
